sections.content_text: Section 115 - Deductions from any Sum paid by Real Estate Developer to Land Owner Where a person involved in the real estate or land development business pays any amount to the land owner as signing money, subsistence money, house rent 15% (fifteen percent) tax shall be deducted on the total amount paid to the owner of the land under power of attorney or under any agreement or written agreement, by whatever name called, for the purpose of land development.
